title: Grok Imagine 2.0
description: xAI Grok Imagine 2.0 — the latest Grok image model: precise editing, infographics, ads, game assets, UI/UX mockups and storyboards. Text-to-image, plus editing from a single input image (the input image is free). Billing: per image, quality × resolution — low 1K = 50, low 2K = 80, medium 1K = 80, medium 2K = 100 credits. Use POST /v1/cost for an exact quote.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Ignored when `image` is supplied — an edit always matches the input image's frame.

image.description: Optional input image to edit (one only — this model has no multi-reference form). Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Costs nothing extra.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. This model returns a single image per request.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or the edit to apply when `image` is supplied.

quality.description: Rendering quality. Combines with `size` to set the price: low bills 50 (1K) / 80 (2K), medium bills 80 (1K) / 100 (2K). This model has no `high` tier.

size.description: Output resolution tier. Combines with `quality` to set the price: 1K bills 50 credits at low quality and 80 at medium.
